params.label: Image to align
params.tip: Which image version to align — usually the raw or drift-corrected one

params.label: Reference channel
params.tip: Channel used to estimate per-plane XY shifts — use the brightest structured channel

params.label: Anchor plane
params.tip: Which plane in each timepoint's stack the others are aligned to

params.label: Minimum PC confidence
params.tip: Reject a plane's fit when the correlation peak is weaker than this

params.label: Max per-plane shift (px)
params.tip: Reject fits over this size — usually structural difference, not motion
